reps.structuredProse:
### ENTITIES:
1. Item:
   - Weight (numeric, measured in kg)
   - Value (numeric)
   - Inclusion status (boolean, must include "First-aid kit")

### DOMAINS:
1. Weight:
   - Possible values are: 2 kg, 3 kg, 4 kg, 5 kg, 6 kg (these correspond to the weights of the individual items).
   
2. Value:
   - Possible values are: 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 (these correspond to the values assigned to the individual items).
   
3. Inclusion status:
   - Possible values are: True (for "First-aid kit" must be included), False (for all other items).

### CONSTRAINTS:
1. The total weight of the items packed must not exceed 10 kg.
2. The "First-aid kit" must be included in the box.
3. Each item can be included at most once; if it is included, it has to be counted in the total weight and total value.
4. The combined weight of the "First-aid kit" and any selected additional items must not exceed the remaining weight capacity of 8 kg (after accounting for the 2 kg weight of the "First-aid kit"). 
5. The total value of the items packed must be maximized.
reps.mzn:
include "globals.mzn";

% Define the weights and values of the items
enum ITEM = {FIRST_AID_KIT, ITEM_1, ITEM_2, ITEM_3, ITEM_4};

array[ITEM] of int: weight = [2, 3, 4, 5, 6]; % Weights in kg
array[ITEM] of int: value = [4, 5, 6, 7, 8];  % Values assigned to the items

% Decision variable for inclusion status of items (boolean)
array[ITEM] of var 0..1: include; % 1 for include, 0 for not include

% Constraints
constraint sum(i in ITEM)(weight[i] * include[i]) <= 10; % Total weight must not exceed 10 kg
constraint include[FIRST_AID_KIT] == 1; % First-aid kit must be included
constraint forall(i in ITEM)(include[i] <= 1); % Each item can be included at most once
constraint sum(i in ITEM)(weight[i] * include[i]) <= 8 + weight[FIRST_AID_KIT]; % Remaining capacity after First-aid kit
constraint sum(i in ITEM)(value[i] * include[i]) == max(sum(i in ITEM)(value[i] * include[i])); % Maximize total value
